_doc: Default stomach properties for an average adult, and the rules that turn clinical flags into continuous properties (Pillar 3). profile_builder.py starts from defaults, applies clinical_modifiers for any true flag, then overlays any learned_physiology from the Bayesian loop.
calibration_note: Rate constants (k_co2_release, cck_feedback strength, emptying t1/2) are set in utils/calibration.py against published gastric-emptying data: liquids t1/2 ~20 min, solids ~2 h, fat slows emptying via CCK feedback.
